hypothesis: A 4-thread CTA may improve the workload by changing CTA scheduling, but it also doubles the CTA count versus the current 8-thread setting and leaves more warp lanes inactive. Prior results for 12 threads were faster than baseline, but do not establish that smaller blocks keep improving performance; measure this configuration without assuming a gain.
notes: Only launch geometry changes; traversal, force equations, and memory strategy remain untouched. Preserve the JSON key set. Compare official timings only after the controller validates every supported size. No measurement is available for this proposal.
transformations: Set block and items_per_block to 4 while keeping shared_memory_bytes at 0; leave the kernel source unchanged.
